standard-dialogue-without-an-m-speak-amu.player: I have no idea what you just said, but good luck with it anyway!

options.condition: If the player has not taunted the monkey:
If the player has taunted the monkey:

steps.player: I'm sorry for insulting you. Is there anything I can do to make it up to you?

steps.npc: Hmmmm...well, you seem sincere, how about you hurry up and use me on the tree and we'll call it even.

steps.text: If the player has taunted the monkey:
If the player has cautioned the monkey:

steps.player: Hey monkey, take your time getting the nut ok?

steps.npc: Sure. If I see any monkeys around the top of the tree I'll be careful and try and get you the nut whatever happens.

steps.text: If the player has not taunted or cautioned the monkey:

steps.npc: What? Can I come out of this bag now?

steps.player: That depends, do you think you can reach those bitternuts for me?

steps.npc: Sigh...yes. Just take me to the tree and I'll grab one for you.

options.condition: If the player has not cautioned the monkey:

steps.player: Hey monkey, take your time getting the nut ok?

steps.npc: Sure. If I see any monkeys around the top of the tree I'll be careful and try and get you the nut whatever happens.

options.condition: If the player has cautioned the monkey:

steps.player: Look, never mind about taking your time, I'm sure things will be ok.

steps.npc: Well if you are sure. Ok, I'll get up there and pass you the nut then.

steps.player: Cheers, I'll be nearby to catch it.

sSL_3P.player: Hey monkey, your mother was an inedible seaweed sandwich!

sSL_3P.npc: Oh man, oh, you did not just say that!
The second I get up that tree I am going to pelt you with bitternuts until you are neck deep in them!

sSL_3P.player: Oh noes, my worst nightmare come true...
